WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::date,
        $__timeTo()::date,
        '1 day'::interval
    ) AS day
),
filtered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        time_of_sample_collection AS time,
        result AS "COD(mg/l)"
    FROM 
        user_labtestdata 
    WHERE 
        form_id = 163
        AND location = 'PAC (Product)'
        AND type_of_lab_test LIKE 'COD%'
        AND time_of_sample_collection BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
        AND notes ILIKE ANY (
            ARRAY(
                SELECT '%' || trim(value) || '%'
                FROM unnest(ARRAY[${PAC_Product}]) AS value
            )
        )
),
missing_dates AS (
    SELECT d.day AS time
    FROM date_series d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM filtered_data f
        WHERE f.time::date = d.day
    )
)
SELECT * FROM filtered_data
UNION
SELECT time, NULL AS "COD(mg/l)" FROM missing_dates
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
    AVG(result) AS "Average COD(mg/l):"
FROM 
    user_labtestdata 
WHERE 
    form_id = 163
    AND location = 'PAC (Product)'
    AND type_of_lab_test = 'COD(mg/l)'
    AND time_of_sample_collection BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND notes ILIKE ANY (
                    ARRAY(
                    SELECT '%' || trim(value) || '%'
                 FROM unnest(ARRAY[${PAC_Product}]) AS value
                 )
                 );
